name: long-context-analysis
prompt: Analyze the following log excerpt and diagnose why throughput collapsed. Explain the root cause and propose a fix. The service handles roughly four thousand requests per second at steady state across twelve worker processes. Between 02:14 and 02:19 the p99 latency rose from forty milliseconds to eleven seconds while CPU utilisation stayed near thirty percent and memory grew steadily. Connection pool saturation warnings appeared at 02:15 followed by a burst of timeout errors from the downstream inventory service. At 02:16 the circuit breaker opened for that dependency, and queued requests began failing fast. The queue depth metric shows a sawtooth pattern that repeats every ninety seconds, aligned with a scheduled reconciliation job that scans the entire orders table without a limit clause. Garbage collection pauses remained under ten milliseconds throughout. After the reconciliation job completed at 02:19, latency recovered within thirty seconds without intervention, and the circuit breaker closed at 02:20. A similar pattern appears in the logs from the previous three nights at the same hour, each lasting between four and six minutes, and each preceded by the same reconciliation job start message.
